|game_text=Deploy on table. Target a Skywalker who has completed Jedi Test #5. While target on Dagobah, 'move phase' on Save You It Can may be treated as 'deploy phase.' Attempt during your move phase when Vader with target (even as a non-frozen captive). Vader and target duel: Each player draws destiny. Add ability. Highest total wins. If target wins, test completed: Leave on table. Add one battle destiny in every battle. Also, target is immune to attrition &lt; 5.
